newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PT Citra Marga unit mandates bond issue.
newsitem.headline: PT Citra Marga unit mandates bond issue.

text.p: PT Citra Marga Nusaphala BV has mandated Peregrine Fixed Income to arrange a five-year US$100 million 144a note issue, bankers said on Tuesday.
The notes will be guaranteed by Indonesian toll-road operator PT Citra Marga Nusaphala Persada.
Bankers said Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette and SBC Warburg are co-lead managers.
Roadshows are scheduled to begin next week and the launch is expected in February.
On Monday, Standard and Poor's Corp assigned a BBB-minus rating to the proposed issue.
Citra Marga Nusaphala also has mandated Peregrine Sewu Securities to arrange a seven-year 250 billion rupiah bond issue.

In December, Citra corporate finance manager Ilham Wardhana Siregar said the dollar-denominated bond would carry an interest rate of 8.25 percent and mature in five years, while the rupiah bond would have an interest rate of 17 percent and mature in seven years.
